snippet.title: Empire in Decay - Announcement Trailer | Tactical Roguelike Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
Wishlist Empire in Decay on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345260/Empire_in_Decay/

Empire in Decay is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world, developed by Siesta Games and published by Stardock. It launches on Steam in early 2027.

The empire is dying and the throne is up for grabs. Your job is to lead a rebellion and take it.

You'll fight nine enemy factions in battles that mix card play with chess-style movement on the board. You have to attack and defend at the same time. Any enemy unit that makes it to your end of the board starts wiping out your followers, and those losses carry over from one round to the next. Lose all of them and it's game over.

In every fight you control a main faction and a secondary faction. You start with the Damerites and the Guild, and unlock the Groundbreakers Society and the Soul Harvesters as you play through the campaign. Each faction has its own special abilities and cards, and with more than 200 cards across all four, there's plenty of room to experiment with your decks.

Empire in Decay is the second game signed under Stardock's expanded publishing program. Siesta Games is an independent studio in Zaragoza, Spain, started by AAA veterans who wanted to make the kind of games they'd love to play themselves.
